User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the TNPSC Ace application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

registrationDate.description: Date and time the user registered.

isAdmin.description: Indicates if the user has administrative privileges.

Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: Represents a subject in the TNPSC exam syllabus.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Subject entity.

name.description: Name of the subject (e.g., History, Geography).

description.description: A brief description of the subject.

Class.title: Class
Class.description: Represents an academic class (e.g., Class 6, Class 7).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Class entity.

name.description: Name of the class (e.g., Class 6, Class 7).

description.description: A brief description of the class.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a question in an MCQ test.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Question entity.

correctAnswerIndex.description: The index of the correct answer within the answer options array.

answerOptions.description: Array of possible answers for the question.

Test.title: Test
Test.description: Represents a test (Subject-wise, Class-wise or Previous Year).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Test entity.

name.description: Name of the test (e.g., 'History Class 6 Test').

description.description: A brief description of the test.

subjectId.description: Reference to Subject.  (Relationship: Subject 1:N Test) Nullable if it's a Previous Year Paper.

classId.description: Reference to Class. (Relationship: Class 1:N Test) Nullable if it's a Previous Year Paper.

isPreviousYearPaper.description: Indicates if the test is a previous year question paper.

questionIds.description: References to Questions. (Relationship: Test N:N Question)

UserTestAttempt.title: UserTestAttempt
UserTestAttempt.description: Represents a user's attempt at a particular test.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserTestAttempt entity.

attemptDate.description: Date and time the test was attempted.

score.description: The user's score on the test.

answers.description: Array of user's answers; each entry corresponds to the index of the question.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to support the TNPSC Ace application, focusing on class-wise, subject-wise, and previous year MCQ tests. The design emphasizes authorization independence, clarity, and scalability.  We are using path-based ownership for user data and a membership map approach for collaborative data. The key collections are `users`, `subjects`, `classes`, `questions`, `tests`, and `userTestAttempts`. User-specific data is stored under `/users/{userId}`. Questions are organized under subjects and classes enabling efficient querying and filtering of questions. Tests are designed to have many-to-many relationships with questions using the `questionIds` array. User attempts are stored separately, linking back to users and tests. This structure allows for efficient score tracking and personalized insights.
